note: Frames behind HEF build o2s. calibration: the 1,024 frames in the order the Dataflow Compiler received them (the seeded shuffle of compile_yolox_hef.py; calibration_order.txt there, SHA-256 in acceptance.json); acceptance: the 64 held-out validation frames of the SNR check. source_image is the image within the dataset as downloaded (sdg_coco: NVIDIA SDG warehouse runs as COCO frames; ss_frames: frames of NVIDIA PhysicalAI-SmartSpaces videos named <scene>_<camera>_<frame>; loco: LOCO; keremberke: keremberke/forklift-object-detection); source_sha256 is the SHA-256 of that image file, which compile_yolox_hef.py letterboxed like compact_vision.preprocess.
calibration_content_rule: SHA-256 of one line per frame in calibration order: "<name> <source_sha256>\n"
